newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle trade up $1 at $68 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle trade up $1 at $68 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was quiet until about 1330 CST, then active for a short period, then quiet, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were $1.00 per cwt higher than last week.

Inquiry good, demand fairly good. Sales confirmed on 19,000 slaughter steers and 15,800 slaughter heifers Wednesday. For the week to date 47,300 head confirmed including 8,700 head or about 18 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1300 lbs 68.00.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 975-1175 lbs 68.00, pen 67.00; few Select with end Choice 950-1115 lbs 66.50.
Wk to date - 47,300 last week - 45,000 last year - 12,100
